name: Trustgraph
description: Trustgraph — a product on the FlashyOS mesh — a running service with a roadmap, a deploy and the invariants it rests on enforced by tests. AAO expands to Agentic Autonomous Organization.

roles.name: product
roles.purpose: Owns what the product does and the order it is built in, and answers to the accountable human for the roadmap it commits to.
roles.measure: Roadmap items shipped, as a share of those planned

roles.name: engineering
roles.purpose: Builds and maintains the codebase, and keeps the invariants the product rests on enforced by a test rather than a guideline.
roles.measure: Changes carrying a test, as a share of merges

roles.name: operations
roles.purpose: Runs the deploy and keeps the service up. A change to production waits for a named human at or above the critical floor — no agent ships to prod on its own say-so.
roles.measure: Deploys that stay green, as a share of deploys

roles.name: review
roles.purpose: Reviews and approves a change before it lands. Agents suggest; humans consent; nothing reaches the default branch without an approving review.
roles.measure: Merges carrying an approving review, as a share of merges

roles.name: conformance
roles.purpose: Runs the tests, the lint and the mesh conformance check, and holds the default branch to what those checks require.
roles.measure: Checks passing on the default branch, as a share of runs
